name: Sanctum of the Shepherd

components.m: adamantine or diamond powder worth 200+ GP, which the spell consumes

targets.description: you and up to your spellcasting modifier (minimum 1) other creatures of your choice

summary: A 20-foot Sphere of shimmering light for 24 hours: you and chosen creatures who finish a Long Rest in it gain +1 AC for the rest of the 24 hours.
text: Over 1 minute you raise a 20-foot-radius Sphere of faint, shimmering light centred on a point within 5 feet; the powder is consumed. You and a number of other creatures of your choice equal to your spellcasting ability modifier (minimum 1) can draw in its protective magic. When any chosen creature finishes a Long Rest inside the Sphere, the Sphere vanishes and every chosen creature that finished that Long Rest in it gains a +1 bonus to AC for the remainder of the 24 hours. A chosen creature that did not finish a Long Rest in the Sphere gets nothing.
